Explanation:
I compared the Predicted Answer and the Ground Truth Answer. Both lists contain the same five songs by musical groups from the year 1985:
1. "Careless Whisper" by Wham!
2. "Wake Me Up Before You Go-Go" by Wham!
3. "I Want to Know What Love Is" by Foreigner
4. "Out of Touch" by (Daryl) Hall & Oates
5. "Everybody Wants to Rule the World" by Tears for Fears

The Predicted Answer provides minor clarifications (e.g., “Wham! featuring George Michael” and “Daryl Hall & John Oates”), but these do not alter the substance. The order and identities of the songs and groups match exactly between both answers.

Decision: TRUE
